page.overview:
Who is Abu Mussan?

After becoming a one man army by using the sword, Abu came to the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Phil Coulson. Taking a team of agents with him to Sharzhad to investigate, Phill was able to piece together what had happened.

Abu surprised the team by using the sword to break through a brick wall crowning himself the new god and king of this sacred land, but Phill came prepared for a swordfight in the form of the Black Knight and Valkyrie.

Abu was able to hold his own against the two heroes until his body started to reabsorb the energies from the attacks he made against the Black Knight's shield causing his body to become frail which allowed Valkyrie to strike him down with her sword Dragonfang.
